authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9661 bhrātṛ gives bhāi/bhāī/bhāua brother and ordinary regional forms. The survey bhaiya/bhaiwa and phāī fit that family with inflection/address endings and initial aspiration preserved. Reviewed comparison: Kathoriya bhaⁱya “younger brother” (f_qnmxaaa7k3vmc). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
